index.value: Solactive GBS Developed Markets ex Australia Large & Mid Cap Index
index.note: About 1,000+ developed-market companies outside Australia (1,310 components at 30 Sep 2026). Not currency hedged; HGBL is the AUD-hedged version.

mer.note: Management fee and costs; Betashares notes certain additional costs (e.g. transaction costs) apply, see PDS

yield.note: 12-month distribution yield as at 30 Sep 2026 (prior 12 months' distributions / closing NAV at period end)

franking.note: Not stated; global (ex-Australia) shares carry no franking credits

listed.note: First day of trading on the ASX (ASX company listing date). Daily prices start here.

inception.note: Fund inception; listed on the ASX 11 May 2023

distributions.note: Betashares says 'at least annually'; so far it has paid twice a year (ex-dates early January and 1 July)
